2.209.2
Map.ActionInfo
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The Map.ActionInfo element specifies a set of actions for a Map element. The Map.ActionInfo
element is optional. This element is of type ActionInfo.
The following is the parent element of the Map.ActionInfo element.
Parent elements
Map
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Map.ActionInfo element.
 <xsd:element name="ActionInfo" type="ActionInfoType" minOccurs="0" />
